body.message:
We informed the reception because I thought it was a hotel. Then they sent a maintenance worker to check it out. But it turned out not to be something simple. I thought maybe someone upstairs had accidentally spilled water or something and it was dripping downstairs. But that wasn’t the case. Something burst inside the bathroom ceiling drywall/plaster, and now they will have to break open the bathroom ceiling and replace a part to stop the leaking.

They asked us to inform the owner of the rental so they would be aware. I’m not sure what will happen after that — whether they will refund the rest of the stay or move us to another place.
